starterGuidance.prepareWorkspace: Confirm that the workspace, equipment and necessary materials are ready. Record any unresolved issue with the responsible team.

starterGuidance.transferKnowledge: Share the agreed documentation and confirm that the receiving owners can take responsibility.
starterGuidance.returnEquipment: Check the equipment inventory, arrange the return and retain confirmation of receipt.
starterGuidance.reviewAccess: Coordinate the approved access removal with system owners at the appropriate time. Retain confirmation.
starterGuidance.exitConversation: Offer an exit conversation and explain the next administrative steps. Respect the employee’s privacy.
starterGuidance.confirmRole: Confirm the new responsibilities, reporting relationship and transition date with the employee and receiving manager.
starterGuidance.updateAccess: Review the access needed for the new role and coordinate additions and removals with system owners.
starterGuidance.confirmEngagement: Confirm the agreed work, dates, points of contact and required documentation.
